_comment: EXAMPLE conventions pack for a HYPOTHETICAL stack: a Ruby JSON API under app/ + a TypeScript single-page UI under web/, serving Workspaces, Projects, Tasks, Comments, Invoices, Members and Settings. Every rule is here to demonstrate one feature of the format (see README.md). Copy, then delete what is not yours.

rules._comment: A plain `line` rule, non-heuristic: the pattern IS the verdict. Wall-clock reads bypass the per-workspace time zone and make tests flaky.
rules.fix: Use the Clock service (Clock.now / Clock.today) so time is workspace-zoned and test-controllable.

rules._comment: A `line` rule that is a layer-boundary check: UI components call the api client module, never fetch() directly.
rules.rule: Direct HTTP call from a component
rules.fix: Call a method on web/src/api/* instead; components never talk to the network directly, so auth, retries and error toasts stay in one place.

rules._comment: A `file_absent` rule: flag an added subscription only when the WHOLE FILE has no matching unsubscribe. This is the 'you did X but never did Y' shape.
rules.rule: Event subscription with no cleanup anywhere in the file
rules.fix: Pair every addEventListener / socket.on with its removal in the component's cleanup, or handlers leak across navigations.

rules._comment: A HEURISTIC `file_absent` rule — the most valuable and the most dangerous kind. Multi-tenant isolation: an entry-point query in a controller with no workspace scope anywhere in the file. A regex cannot tell a scoped base class from a cross-tenant read, so it is a lead; the gate must read the file and answer confirm_question before it blocks as CRITICAL.
rules.rule: Entry-point query with no workspace scope anywhere in the file
rules.fix: Scope every entry-point query to current_workspace (or inherit a controller base that does). CONFIRM by reading the file — a controller that delegates to a scoped query object is fine.
rules.confirm_question: Does this query actually cross workspaces, or is scoping applied by a base class / query object the file calls?

rules._comment: A `sibling_file` rule — the cross-file check. Every service object needs its spec; {stem} is the basename minus '_service', and the template is a path, so it matches that relative path.
rules.fix: Add spec/services/<name>_service_spec.rb — a service without a spec is the place the next regression hides.

rules._comment: A heuristic style rule using the design system. Literals inside the token DEFINITION file are legitimate, which is exactly why it is a heuristic with an exclude_path AND a confirm_question.
rules.fix: Use a design token (var(--color-…)) instead of a literal; literals drift from the palette and break theming.
rules.confirm_question: Is the literal inside a token definition or a third-party chart config (fine), or in a component style (a violation)?

rules._comment: A rule that uses the {{ticket_key_pattern}} placeholder: a skipped spec must name the ticket that owns re-enabling it.
rules.rule: Skipped spec without a ticket key
rules.fix: Reference the ticket that will un-skip it (`xit 'does X' # PROJ-123`) — a skipped spec with no owner never comes back.

rules._comment: The framework defaults are worth keeping as-is in most packs. Shown here so the pack is complete on its own.
rules.fix: Remove the focus. A focused test silently skips the rest of the suite.
Never commit a credential. Read it from the environment and rotate the one you just pasted — it is in the diff now.
rules.confirm_question: Is this a real credential, or a placeholder / documentation value that could never authenticate anything?

rules.rule: TODO / FIXME without a ticket key
rules.fix: Reference the ticket that owns the follow-up (`TODO PROJ-123: …`).

projects._comment: Which paths imply which CI-parity commands. `build: null` means the project has no build step. These must be the EXACT commands CI runs.
projects.name: api

domain_glossary.Workspace: the tenant; every row belongs to exactly one, and no query may cross it
domain_glossary.Project: a container of Tasks inside a Workspace
domain_glossary.Task: the unit of work; has an assignee (a Member), a status and Comments
domain_glossary.Comment: a threaded note on a Task
domain_glossary.Invoice: a billing document for a Workspace; the sensitive area that never auto-ships
domain_glossary.Member: a user inside a Workspace with one of the roles owner / admin / member / observer
domain_glossary.Settings: per-Workspace configuration; changes here are shared-core edits
